skill.name: azure-resource-visualizer
skill.description: Analyze Azure resource groups and create Mermaid architecture diagrams that show resources, configuration details, and relationships.
skill.summary: Create Mermaid diagrams and Markdown documentation from Azure resource group metadata.
skill.author: microsoft

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown, Mermaid syntax, sample private CIDR ranges, and documentation text. The skill does intentionally use Azure MCP tools and Azure CLI for read-only cloud inventory, which can expose infrastructure topology. No prompt injection evidence was found.

remediation.issue: Azure CLI and MCP inventory commands can expose cloud topology.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user selection and scope every query to the chosen subscription and resource group.

remediation.issue: The command parameter guidance is broad for Azure operations.
remediation.suggestion: Limit generated commands to read-only list, show, and graph query operations.

remediation.issue: Generated architecture documents may include sensitive infrastructure details.
remediation.suggestion: Keep secrets as placeholders, omit secret values, and let users choose where reports are written.

content.value_statement: Azure resource groups can be hard to explain from service lists. This skill queries Azure metadata and creates Mermaid diagrams with clear relationships.
actual_capabilities: Lists Azure resource groups when no group is specified.
Queries resources in a selected group through Azure MCP tools or Azure CLI.
Maps network, data, identity, and dependency relationships between resources.
Generates Mermaid diagrams grouped by logical architecture layers.
Creates Markdown architecture files from the included template.
limitations: Requires Azure read permissions and an available Azure MCP tool or Azure CLI.
Does not modify or delete Azure resources.
Diagram accuracy depends on the metadata available to the agent.
Large environments may need multiple diagrams for clear review.

use_cases.title: Document a Cloud Architecture
use_cases.description: Create a readable diagram and report for an Azure resource group before a design review.

use_cases.title: Explain Production Dependencies
use_cases.description: Map compute, data, network, and identity relationships for a service support handoff.

use_cases.title: Review Resource Topology
use_cases.description: Inspect resource relationships and note important access paths before a security review.

prompt_templates.title: Diagram One Resource Group
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Azure Resource Visualizer to diagram resource group <name>. Ask me before running Azure queries if the group is unclear.

prompt_templates.title: Create Architecture Documentation
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze resource group <name> in subscription <subscription>. Create a Markdown architecture report with an inventory, Mermaid diagram, and relationship notes.

prompt_templates.title: Map Network and Identity Paths
prompt_templates.prompt: Map network paths, managed identities, private endpoints, and data flows for resource group <name>. Call out unclear relationships for review.

prompt_templates.title: Split a Large Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Azure Resource Graph patterns to inventory resource group <name>. Split the output into compute, data, network, security, and monitoring views when needed.

output_examples.output: A Markdown architecture document with a resource inventory, layered Mermaid diagram, and notes about network, data, and identity paths.
A numbered list of available resource groups, followed by a request for the user to choose one before analysis continues.

output_examples.input: The resource group has more than fifty resources.
output_examples.output: Multiple focused diagrams grouped by layer, with a summary that links shared dependencies and external connections.

best_practices: Confirm the subscription and resource group before running Azure queries.
Keep generated diagrams in a docs folder when the workspace has one.
Replace secrets and connection strings with meaningful placeholder names.
anti_patterns: Do not run Azure create, update, delete, or role assignment commands.
Do not include secret values, keys, or full connection strings in diagrams.
Do not assume relationships when Azure metadata does not confirm them.

faq.question: Does this skill change Azure resources?
faq.answer: No. It is designed for read-only analysis and documentation.

faq.question: What permissions are required?
faq.answer: It needs permission to list resource groups and read resource details in the target scope.

faq.question: Can it use Azure CLI?
faq.answer: Yes. It can use Azure CLI when Azure MCP tools are unavailable or insufficient.

faq.question: Will it include secrets?
faq.answer: It should use placeholder names for secrets and never place secret values in diagrams.

faq.question: What output does it create?
faq.answer: It creates a Markdown architecture document with a Mermaid diagram and relationship notes.

faq.question: Can it handle large resource groups?
faq.answer: Yes, but large groups may need multiple diagrams organized by layer or service area.
